name: Pradhan Mantri Formalisation of Micro Food Processing Enterprises (PMFME)
description: Provides support for eligible micro food processing enterprises, including credit-linked capital subsidy for individual micro food processing units.
eligibility_rules: Applicant should be involved in an eligible micro food processing activity.
Individual micro food processing units may receive credit-linked capital subsidy of 35% of eligible project cost, subject to a maximum of Rs.10 lakh per unit.
Beneficiary contribution should be at least 10% of the project cost.

name: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme (PMEGP)
description: A credit-linked subsidy programme supporting eligible new micro-enterprises in manufacturing and service/trading activities.
eligibility_rules: The applicant must satisfy the eligibility conditions specified in the current PMEGP guidelines.
Maximum project cost for manufacturing units is Rs.50 lakh.
Maximum project cost for service/trading units is Rs.20 lakh.
Bank financing and beneficiary contribution are subject to the applicable PMEGP guidelines.
documents: Educational or training documents where applicable

name: Pradhan Mantri MUDRA Yojana (PMMY)
description: Provides collateral-free institutional credit to eligible micro enterprises for income-generating activities.
eligibility_rules: Loans are intended for eligible non-agricultural income-generating micro enterprise activities, including specified allied agricultural activities.
Shishu loans are up to Rs.50,000.
Kishore loans are above Rs.50,000 and up to Rs.5 lakh.
Tarun loans are above Rs.5 lakh and up to Rs.10 lakh.
Tarun Plus loans are above Rs.10 lakh and up to Rs.20 lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid a previous Tarun-category loan.
